svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut one piece 55 x 44 mm from 1.0 mm insulating gap pad sheet

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a sharp knife on a cutting mat; keep the liner on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drawn at 0.7 mm: the thickness it is squeezed to in place.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It lies on the plate under the eight MOSFETs: from 100 to 155 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in from the plate's left edge, centred across the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Peel one liner, press it onto the clean plate, then peel the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: other liner just before the board goes on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Do not stretch it; replace it if it tears or picks up a chip:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it is the only insulation between the MOSFETs and the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no bubbles; 55 x 44 mm within 1 mm.
